data.name: Elden
data.gender_notes: Elden is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'eald', meaning 'old', and the Old Norse word 'denn', meaning 'ruler' or 'lord'. In early Germanic societies, Elden could have referred to a wise and experienced leader. The name Elden carries the meaning “Old, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elden usually hope their child will grow to embody old, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Elden belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Old, ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elden total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אלדן
in_hebrew.meaning: אלדן - שם פרטי שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השופט שלי'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלדן הוא שם פרטי שמקורו באנגלית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השופט שלי'. השם אלדן נגזר מהמילים האנגליות 'אלד' שמשמעותו 'אלוהים' ו'ען' שמשמעותו 'שופט'. השם אלדן אינו מופיע באופן ישיר בתנ'ך העברי, אך הוא קשור למושגים של שיפוט אלוהי וצדק.

in_greek.name: Έλντεν
in_greek.meaning: Το Έλντεν σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου'
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Έλντεν είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος Έλντεν συνδέεται με τις αγγλικές λέξεις 'eld' που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και 'en' που σημαίνει 'κριτής'. Αν και το όνομα Έλντεν δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα στην Καινή Διαθήκη, συνδέεται με έννοιες της θείας κρίσεως και δικαιοσύνης.

in_latin.name: Elden
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elden origine Anglicum habet et significat 'Deus est iudex meus'. Etymologia nominis Elden coniungitur cum vocibus Anglicis 'eld' quae significat 'Deus' et 'en' quae significat 'iudex'. Quamquam nomen Elden non directe in Scripturis apparet, tamen coniungitur cum conceptibus de divina iudicatione et iustitia.

in_english.name: Elden
in_english.long_meaning: The name Elden originates from English and means 'God is my judge'. It is derived from the Old English words 'eld' meaning 'God' and 'en' meaning 'judge'. Although the name Elden does not appear directly in the Bible, it is associated with concepts of divine judgment and justice. Historically, the name Elden has been used in Christian traditions to signify faith in God's judgment and sovereignty. The spiritual significance of the name Elden emphasizes trust in God's justice and righteousness.
